adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow is implemented with a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and never calls the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper that other integrations were updated to use. Since `refreshOAuthTokens` is the mechanism that switches to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is on, Salesforce refresh will ignore credential sync while other apps honor it, leading to inconsistent/broken behavior for the credential sync feature.
